sloka: विश्वामित्रस्तु धर्मात्मा मम पित्रा सुपूजित: ।प्रोवाच पितरं तत्र भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥ २.११८.४५॥
transliteration: viśvāmitrastu dharmātmā mama pitrā supūjita: ।provāca pitaraṁ tatra bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ॥ 2.118.45॥

translations.english: Having accepted the honour extended by my father, righteous Viswamitra spoke to him about those two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana.
